speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help narrow down the cause of your fever and headache, how many weeks pregnant are you, and have you noticed any rash or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, or noticed a decrease in fetal movement? REQUEST TEST: Urine_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent consumption of ice cream, have you experienced any gastrointestinal symptoms like nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea? REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood culture results indicate a Listeria monocytogenes infection, which is a significant risk during pregnancy. Do you have any history of immune suppression, and have you consumed other unpasteurized dairy products or deli meats recently? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood culture confirms Listeria monocytogenes, so we can rule out meningitis given the normal MRI. I will initiate immediate antibiotic therapy with ampicillin to treat the bacteremia and protect the fetus. DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis
